Class SandboxRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.mobybank.harness.infrastructure.sbx.SandboxRegistry
@ApplicationScoped public class SandboxRegistry extends Object
Remembers which sandbox currently backs each session, and the agent's own conversation id inside it so the next turn can resume. Sandbox names follow harness-<session>-g<generation>; each move creates the next generation, which lets the adapters find a session's sandbox again after a restart by listing sandboxes.
